title: Sting Operation Airs
text: A hidden camera catches your fixer counting notes. The tape runs on every channel by nightfall.

title: Coalition Walks Out
text: Your loudest ally storms out of the press conference — and takes half your leverage with him.

title: The Diary Surfaces
text: A dead fixer's diary reaches a magistrate. Your initials appear on eleven pages.

title: Election Commission Probe
text: Auditors arrive with empty boxes and leave with full ones. Your accounts are frozen while they read.

title: Hush Money Ledger Leaks
text: The payments were supposed to be quiet. The spreadsheet was not.

title: Smear Ad Backfires
text: Your attack ad is debunked live on air, frame by frame. The apology tour is expensive.

title: Midnight Tax Raid
text: Agencies raid your office on an anonymous tip. Nothing is found, but the photographs stick forever.

title: Burned in Effigy
text: Your likeness goes up in flames on the district's main road. The footage loops all week.

title: Hot Mic
text: You said what you actually think. The microphone was on. The clip has subtitles in four languages.

title: Scam Makes the Front Page
text: A ledger with your initials leads the morning edition. Page two is a helpful diagram.

title: Prime-Time Blackout
text: Your ad slots are pulled an hour before broadcast. The invoice, mysteriously, is not refunded.

title: Heckled Off Stage
text: The crowd came with questions. You left without answers, through the kitchen.

title: Defamation Suit Lands
text: You called him a crook on the record. His lawyers called your bank.

title: Draft Manifesto Leaks
text: The internal version promised everything to everyone. Now everyone has read everyone else's promise.

title: Rally Cheques Bounce
text: The tent men, the sound men, and the chair men all went unpaid — and they all know reporters.

title: The Old Speech Resurfaces
text: Twenty years ago you argued, passionately, the exact opposite. Someone kept the VHS.

title: Crowd Turns Ugly
text: Your rally in this constituency ends in a brawl over the free lunch. Supporters melt away before the cameras do.

title: Ward Bosses Go Dark
text: Two of your booth captains quietly stop returning calls. Their blocks go with them.

title: Ghost Voters Exposed
text: Voters who don't exist apparently voted for you. The ones who do exist are furious.

title: Volunteers Walk Out
text: Your booth workers didn't get paid. They leave mid-canvass, loudly, with the voter lists.

title: Hostile Recount
text: A magistrate orders a recount in this constituency. Your tally comes up short — twice.

title: Shrine Dispute Erupts
text: Your local strongman picked a fight over a boundary wall. The neighbourhood picked the wall.

title: Free Press Field Day
text: Your stunt hands every editor a headline. Unfortunately, your rivals give better quotes.

title: Party Splinters
text: Your dissidents hold their own rally across town. Every rival sends flowers and photographers.

title: Anonymous Donor Steps Up
text: A briefcase arrives at your campaign office. Nobody asks whose it is. Nobody ever does.

title: Thirty Seconds Go Viral
text: One unscripted answer, ten million views. Even your rivals share the clip before they can stop themselves.

title: Superstar Endorsement
text: A film star says your name on stage. The crowd forgets what the rally was about. So do you.

title: Sympathy Wave
text: A shoe hurled at you misses by inches. Your bruised dignity trends for a week.

title: Cleared by the Court
text: The old case against you collapses. You frame the acquittal and hang it where the cameras can see.

title: Grassroots Surge
text: Local volunteers organize door-to-door overnight, unpaid and unasked. The constituency swings on its own.

title: The Procession Passes Through
text: A festival crowd hears you speak from a temple cart. By evening, whole lanes have made up their minds.

title: Rival Scandal Breaks
text: An opponent's dirty laundry airs at the perfect moment — and for once, you didn't even pay for the wash.

title: Ward Boss Crosses Over
text: The neighbourhood strongman switches sides at a garlanded ceremony — and brings his people with him.

title: Party Ticket Up for Sale
text: A safe bloc of votes goes on the block. Every campaign wants it — going once…

title: The Kingmaker Opens Bidding
text: A regional strongman auctions his followers to the highest chequebook. Loyalty sold as-is, no returns.

title: Defecting Bloc Seeks Buyer
text: A whole ward is up for grabs. The middleman insists on cash, cameras off.
